---
title: "Reset Password"
---
```{=html}
<div class="auth-card">
  <h2>Reset Your Password</h2>

  <!-- Step 1: Request reset email -->
  <div id="reset-request-form">
    <p style="color:#666;">
      Enter your email address to receive a password reset link.
      This is for <strong>teacher accounts only</strong>.
      Student passwords are reset by teachers.
    </p>

    <form onsubmit="handleTeacherPasswordReset(event)">
      <div class="form-group">
        <label for="reset-email">Email Address</label>
        <input type="email" id="reset-email" placeholder="your@email.com" required />
      </div>
      <button type="submit" class="btn-primary-custom">Send Reset Link</button>
      <div id="reset-status" class="status-message"></div>
    </form>

    <div class="auth-link">
      <a href="login.html">Back to login</a>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Step 2: Set new password (shown after clicking reset link) -->
  <div id="reset-password-form" style="display:none;">
    <p style="color:#666;">Enter your new password below.</p>

    <form onsubmit="handleNewPassword(event)">
      <div class="form-group">
        <label for="new-password">New Password</label>
        <input type="password" id="new-password" placeholder="At least 8 characters" minlength="8" required />
      </div>
      <div class="form-group">
        <label for="confirm-password">Confirm New Password</label>
        <input type="password" id="confirm-password" placeholder="Re-enter password" required />
      </div>
      <button type="submit" class="btn-primary-custom">Update Password</button>
      <div id="new-password-status" class="status-message"></div>
    </form>
  </div>
</div>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>
<script src="js/supabase-config.js"></script>
<script src="js/utils.js"></script>
<script src="js/auth.js"></script>
<script>
  // Check if we're on this page because of a password recovery link
  _supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((event, session) => {
    if (event === 'PASSWORD_RECOVERY') {
      document.getElementById('reset-request-form').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('reset-password-form').style.display = 'block';
    }
  });
</script>
```
